text:
Maya Chen: quick heads-up: running a tiny docs sprint this afternoon to clear a few KV-cache runbook/link issues and a busted curl example. goal: 3 small edits + one snippet patch, ship as separate tiny PRs. timeline: post PRs in ~45m, merge today if possible.
Jordan K: count me in for edits. which pages are affected?
Maya Chen: saw dead anchors and a 404'd example in: content/runtime/kv-cache/index.md, content/runtime/kv-cache/ops.md, content/runbooks/kvcache-debug.md, plus scripts/curl-examples/send-request.sh.
Leo: quick ask 1 who owns runbooks/kvcache-debug? don't want to conflict with any ongoing work.
Gabi: historically my area. i'm happy to own that one today. will add an author note in the PR.
Rachel: i can take the curl snippet; the endpoint moved to /api/v2/send. i'll update and add a test step in the PR CI.
Jordan K: i'll sweep runtime/kv-cache files for orphan anchors and update headings to stable IDs. plan: replace broken links with full section anchors and add frontmatter redirects when needed.
Maya Chen: sweet. suggested commit split: 1) Jordan edits runtime/*, 2) Gabi edits runbook, 3) Rachel updates curl script. i'll open a meta PR that references each tiny PR to track deploy.
Jordan K: i'll run quick grep to list anchors: `rg \"#\" content/runtime/kv-cache -n || true` and then run the docs-bot link-check locally before PR.
docs-bot: FYI automated scan shows 3 anchor failures and 1 external 404 for send-request.sh. will re-scan on merge.
Maya Chen: Leo can you do a fast CR on Jordan's runtime PR? need one tech eyeball.
Leo: yep, ping me when it's up. i'll do a quick pass (<15m).
Gabi: taking runbook now. i'll drop a short note in the header: \"tiny ownership handoff for link fix\".
Rachel: curl PR will include a minimal smoke test and updated README line. i'll also add a comment explaining the endpoint change for future readers.
Jordan K: estimated work: ~20-30m. will tag PR with `docs:kv-cache` and request Leo for review.
Maya Chen: if everything merges, i'll trigger a canary build and ask docs-bot to re-run the scan. aim to close out by EOD. thanks all! :tada:
Leo: sounds good. ready to review. :+1:
Maya Chen: posting PR links in #release-war-room after merge for the canary check.
docs-bot: scheduled re-scan on merge; will comment on PRs with validation output. :white_check_mark:
